obstacle: Login: Chrome native password autofill cannot be triggered programmatically (focus/click leaves username/password empty); space app content lives in an iframe that shows 'Refreshing'. Also the extension controls only ONE tab, so named sessions all share the same tabId.
solution: For login, have user pick the saved credential in the real browser window, or paste creds to fill input[name='username'] and input[type='password']. For a Space's use case, read the page-level meta[name='description'] / og:description instead of scraping the iframe. Trending space order = document order of <article> cards under /spaces (hrefs like /spaces/USER/NAME).
